rollback.note: Tool registry not visible in the evidence.

timeouts.note: This is an LLM service timeout config; the closest available value is per_tool.

execution_isolation.note: Local dispatcher on the host desktop. Picture-in-Picture RDP session per paper Sec. 4. The client-server mode is reachable.
